description: A link that opens BrokersLynk's free search with a question already run, e.g. "2BR Al Reem, budget 2M". The person sees the live matches without an account; contact details are shown only to members.

question.description: What the client is looking for, or the property the broker has, in plain words (at most 1,000 characters).

name: brokerslynk_search_link
